final: SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.birth_date FROM client AS c JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE d.A3 = 'East Bohemia' AND (CASE WHEN length(c.birth_date) = 6 THEN 1900 + CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) ELSE CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) END) BETWEEN 1983 AND 1987 ORDER BY c.client_id
